name: Vampire - Charm - Successes
description: Flavor text for successes a action

results.text: Their gaze softens under the vampire’s spell, eyes glazing over as they smile sweetly, enchanted.
The target sighs deeply, drawn into a trance-like devotion to the ancient undead predator.
A shiver runs down their spine, but their will bends like reeds before the vampire’s hypnotic storm.
Their voice trembles with affection as they step closer, eyes locked onto their newfound protector.
The charm takes hold, their resistance melting away under the vampire’s commanding presence.
